summary: A commercial WordPress landing page for an accessibility typeface: the whole site is set in the font ('This website is in Dyslexie Font'), in long pastel-coloured sections with big blue caps headings. It is sales-led: three product lines, downloadable sample texts, and heavy social proof (reviews, clients, the V&A, research).

instances.look: Fixed 136px translucent white header: logo at left, nav (Home, Lettertype, Producten, FAQ, Dyslexie, Contact), blue SHOP button, flag language switch, account icon, hamburger. It blurs over content and repeats across the stitched crops; nav labels are in Dutch in an otherwise English capture
Three lines 'READ WITH / DYSLEXIE / FONT' in black caps at maximum width on a signal-yellow field
instances.ux: Static; the first screen makes a single statement. The yellow field continues into the two following blocks
instances.learn: An accessibility font can be sold by its own legibility: a three-word imperative at huge size on a high-contrast field is the demo

reconstruction.layout: Yellow field 1245px wide in a boxed row (x=98) continuing to full-bleed background; 3 left-aligned lines fill ~660px height, starting at x≈100
reconstruction.typography: 160px Dyslexie Bold caps, tracked ~0.05em, line height ~1, black

instances.look: A 3D extruded dark lowercase 'd' inside a thin blue arrow ring on yellow; in the mobile capture it is turned so far it reads as a 'p'
instances.ux: WebGL letter that rotates with scroll (data-mode=scroll) and can also be dragged (cursor grab) or set by keyboard (role=slider); an SVG 'd' is the fallback
instances.learn: Turning a 'd' in 3D until it looks like another letter acts out what dyslexic readers report, far better than a sentence could

reconstruction.layout: Centred 650×650px square stage in the yellow band (717px tall)
reconstruction.typography: Letter is a 3D extrusion of the font's d, ~350px; fallback SVG text 350px Helvetica
reconstruction.behaviour: Custom raw WebGL (no library), rotation tied to page scroll, with pointer drag; touch-action pan-y; aria-valuenow 0–100 updates with the rotation; blue arrows show the direction
reconstruction.assets: Extruded glyph mesh, written in inline WebGL

instances.look: Dark 28px paragraph on the same yellow, ending with a small 'This website is in Dyslexie Font'
instances.learn: The line 'This website is in Dyslexie Font' turns every later paragraph into a live specimen

instances.ux: 'How Does It Work' button leads to the font files page; link to the product page
instances.learn: Show the font inside the familiar font dropdown: it answers 'will it work in my software?' without a word
